meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可帮你把聊天频道（如Telegram、Slack）接到AI代理组上：检查当前配置、引导接线、设置隔离级别、增删频道组，并显示连接状态。
howto.when: 在你添加新频道、初始设置期间，或想重新配置现有连接时；也可单独提出管理频道的要求。

say.text: 把某个Telegram群接到我的客服代理组
say.note: Claude会询问隔离方式并生成注册命令

say.text: 显示当前所有频道和代理组的连接情况
say.note: Claude会列出各频道及对应代理组

say.text: 我想把另一个Slack频道也连到这个代理

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can help you connect messaging channels (e.g., Telegram, Slack) to agent groups: it inspects current state, guides wiring, sets isolation levels, adds/removes channel groups, and shows connection summaries.
howto.when_en: Triggers after adding a channel, during initial setup, or when you ask to reconfigure existing connections; also usable standalone to manage channels.

say_en.text: Connect a specific Telegram group to my customer-service agent group
say_en.note: Claude will ask about isolation and generate a register command.

say_en.text: Show current connections between all channels and agent groups
say_en.note: Claude will list channels and their linked groups.

say_en.text: I want to wire another Slack channel to this agent too
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through adding the channel group.
